scope.caution: Development/validation diagnostics influenced by prior inspection, not independent human-reviewed performance or held-out generalization.

independent_cpu_probability_parity.method: learning.export._parity_inputs and exact export_checkpoint CPU sigmoid comparison

qgis.input_policy: Identical original RGB and integer native-pixel mouse clicks; map/screen round trips verified. Smart Recovery OFF. Learned support0.8/avoidance0.0; CPU1/1 threads ORT_SEQUENTIAL.
qgis.score_policy: F1 at2px. Gap scores exclude hidden geometry. p95 is directed saved route to visible reference, not symmetric Hausdorff. Negative pairs have no accuracy reference.

unscored_negative_route_change.distance_method: Source path arc samples <=0.01 native px; exact nearest distance to all continuous target segments. True directed/symmetric maximum is within +0.005px by 1-Lipschitz distance bound.

protocol.cold_construct: LearnedContourEngine.from_bundle including verification and ONNX/ORT imports
protocol.first_prediction: separately timed, then one additional untimed warm-up, then 25 timed predict_tile calls
protocol.input: native 512x512 uint8 RGB, no resize/convert/color transform, decode outside timing
protocol.order: crop order frozen by cohorts; old/new on even crops and new/old on odd crops
protocol.pooling: equal 25-call weight per unique crop; case prompts sharing a crop are not repeated
protocol.prepared_timing: includes uint8-to-FP32 conversion, inference, sigmoid and immutable prior creation
protocol.processes: one fresh subprocess per unique image/model pair, strictly sequential
protocol.rss: process high-water; macOS raw ru_maxrss bytes, Linux KiB x1024; growth clamped at zero
protocol.scope: 17 frozen validation/development diagnostic cases, deduplicated to 11 image SHA256 values

actual_crop_cpu.rss_baseline: After image/PIL/NumPy/engine-source import, before ONNX/ORT/model construction. Process high-water bytes; not whole QGIS RAM.
actual_crop_cpu.limitation: One host, one paired pass, no statistical speed or general accuracy advantage established.

repository_validation.qgis_checks: Actual QGIS17diagnostic comparisons and2x9scenario lifecycle passed; not replaced by pure-suite skips.
